name: Black jelly
summary: Thạch đen is black jelly made from the thạch plant grown in Cao Bang, mild in taste, soft, and smooth.
origin: Cao Bang city, and the eastern route as a name.
howToEat: Have a cool bowl in hot weather, or buy it as a gift to carry home.
